ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels across the central lobes against 20% low-intensity black pixels localized at margins and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black trailing edge band (5-15 pixel width); vertical sequence of 3-4 irregular black blobs along the central fluke axis; single high-contrast focal spot in the upper-medial region of the right lobe; dense black-on-white mottling at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 40-degree interior pixel angle; notch depth extends significantly into the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude micro-serrations along the interior trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks (5-10 pixel variance) at the lateral lobe extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetrical sweep with a slight upward concavity from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex curve at the outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast dark-on-white pixel groups localized at the terminal points of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular erosion and jagged physical degradation of the lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
